articles.t: "Boss, What About Us?" Pocketpair Grants Special Leave for GTA 6 Launch
articles.chapeau: Palworld developer Pocketpair announced on November 12 that it will grant its employees a five-day special holiday to coincide with the release of GTA 6. The leave period runs from November 19, when GTA 6 launches, through November 23.
articles.txt:
Korean (한국어) KO Add us on Palworld developer Pocketpair announced on November 12 that it will grant its employees a five-day special holiday to coincide with the release of GTA 6. The leave period runs from November 19, when GTA 6 launches, through November 23. Any employee intending to play GTA 6 is eligible to take time off. However, since November 21 and 22 fall on a weekend, the actual time off work consists of three business days: November 19, 20, and 23.
Pocketpair shared the news by posting an image of the internal notice on the official Palworld X (formerly Twitter) account. In the notice, the company wrote that on November 19, millions of gamers around the world would find themselves sitting at school or work, gazing longingly out the window while waiting for a new era of gaming to begin.
Pocketpair explained that such a historic occasion deserves full attention. During the leave, instead of working, employees were advised to take a business trip to Vice City, the virtual city that serves as the setting for GTA 6. In the X post, the company referred to this time off as an "urgent business trip to Vice City."
The notice also included a separate section reassuring players that update work for Palworld and Craftopia is progressing smoothly and will proceed as scheduled. This appears to address concerns from users that the announcement of special leave might delay upcoming updates. Pocketpair CEO Takuro Mizobe also posted on his personal X account, stating that he will be taking a break for a while to play GTA 6.
This is not the first time Pocketpair has declared a day off for a major game release. In February 2025, the studio designated February 28—the release date of Capcom's Monster Hunter Wilds—as a company-wide holiday, excluding a few essential departments. At the time, the studio cited a high number of employees reporting that they might be "feeling unwell."
Meanwhile, company closures tied to the release of GTA 6 have also surfaced outside the gaming industry. Burger Motorsports, an automotive performance parts manufacturer based in California, announced in an Instagram post on June 11 that it would pause company operations for the day on November 19. Management explained that after several team members notified them they would be taking the day off, operating normally would be difficult. Additionally, an engineer battalion at Fort Stewart in Georgia offered a four-day leave tied to the release of GTA 6 as a reenlistment incentive for soldiers signing a four-year contract extension.
GTA 6 will launch on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Originally targeted for fall 2025, the release date was delayed to May 26, 2026, before being pushed back again to November 19, when it was finally set. A release date for the PC version has not yet been announced.

articles.t: GTA 6 Map And Locations – Every Area In Vice City And Leonida - Explosion Network
articles.chapeau: What we know about the GTA 6 map with every confirmed location in Leonida, including Vice City
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto VI takes place across Vice City and new areas, and Rockstar Games’ latest open-world game will extend well beyond the familiar streets of its fictional Miami-inspired setting.
The game takes place across Leonida, a fictional American state inspired by Florida; Rockstar has revealed six major locations ahead of the game’s November 19 release, giving a sense of how varied the new setting will be.
Here’s every major location confirmed for the GTA 6 map so far.
Rockstar has revealed several locations across Leonida through trailers, screenshots, and its official website, but it hasn’t made the complete map publicly available yet. We’ll update this article once the full map is available.
Rockstar has also announced plans to release a downloadable map of Leonida alongside the game’s November 19 launch.
Vice City is the main urban setting of Grand Theft Auto VI, bringing players back to a location first introduced in the original Grand Theft Auto and made famous by Grand Theft Auto: Vice City in 2002.
The city looks like it’s changed considerably since its previous appearances, with Rockstar presenting a modern version inspired by Miami’s beaches, nightlife, luxury developments and surrounding neighbourhoods.
Several areas within Vice City have already been confirmed, including Ocean Beach, Little Cuba, the Tisha-Wocka flea market and the VC Port.
The Leonida Keys are a chain of tropical islands inspired by the Florida Keys, located away from Vice City’s busy streets.
Grassrivers is Leonida’s wetland region, inspired by Florida’s Everglades.
Port Gellhorn is a coastal location that has seen better days.
Ambrosia is an industrial area in the heart of Leonida, where traditional industries remain a major part of the local economy.
Mount Kalaga National Park sits towards Leonida’s northern border and introduces a wilderness setting to the game.
Rockstar has confirmed that the park features hunting, fishing and off-road trails, alongside forests and remote communities.
Rockstar hasn’t confirmed the exact size of the Grand Theft Auto VI map or provided an official comparison with Grand Theft Auto V.
A proper comparison with Los Santos and Blaine County will need to wait until the complete map is available.
Yes. Rockstar has already confirmed that Grand Theft Auto VI takes place across the wider state of Leonida, not just Vice City.
Grand Theft Auto VI releases on November 19, 2026, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

articles.t: Could GTA 6 Be A Better Car-Customization Game Than Need For Speed? - SVG
articles.chapeau: "Grand Theft Auto 6" boasts more horsepower than ever when it comes to its cars. It may be enough to make dedicated racing franchises nervous.
articles.txt:
Rockstar Games Add SVG on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover "Grand Theft Auto 6" is the most ambitious game that Rockstar has ever developed. Even though the "GTA 6" multiplayer will be missing in action at launch, fans are still ready to sink hundreds of hours into Rockstar's latest masterpiece. The new game is so massive and filled with side activities that it's practically half a dozen video games rolled into one. "GTA 6" is an action game, a cinematic narrative game, a relationship simulator, and a fully functional racing game all at the same time. It's the last one that looks like it's about to receive a big boost in focus.
Cars have always been a major detail in "GTA" games, but "GTA 6" is going above and beyond with its car mechanics. The "GTA 6" extended look on Netflix showed us how added security measures on certain cars will make hijacking a more fraught experience than it's ever been before. Once players have secured some wheels, the new game provides them with a dizzying array of customization options to make the vehicle their own. Rockstar has added so many small details to the "GTA 6" car system that dedicated racing game players might even be tempted to set aside "Need for Speed" to cruise the streets of Vice City in style.
Rockstar Games "Need for Speed" is one of the most beloved racing franchises of all time. Players turn to "Need for Speed" games when they want a streamlined racing experience, a deep roster of vehicles to choose from, and a slew of options to tune a car to their preferences. When we started seeing the customization features Rockstar put into "GTA 6," we quickly thought that the new game could end up giving "Need for Speed" a run for its money.
Car races are one of the many side activities Rockstar has confirmed for "GTA 6." With racing being a major focus, it shouldn't be surprising that the developers invested in elaborate car mechanics for the game. Players will be able to take their vehicles to shops that offer upgrades for engines, brakes, suspensions, transmissions, and other performance-centric features. With enough money, players will be able to make their cars outrace everything in the state of Leonida. That's a lot for a game that technically isn't a racing title, like "Need for Speed" is.
Cars in "GTA" games are also a major way players explore the map while expressing their own style. In past "GTA" games players would spend countless hours searching for the perfect car, but "GTA 6" is going to take that process further. In addition to performance upgrades, players will also be able to customize car bodies, wheels, paint jobs, and even interiors. With all the cosmetics the game will have on offer, "GTA 6" could end up being a better car customization game than any "Need for Speed" we've played yet. Emphasis on could, because there's a potential drawback in the wings, and it's way up there with the various microtransaction nibbles racing gamers already face.
Rockstar Games Fans are beyond excited to finally get their hands on "GTA 6" for a lot reasons, but one will be to trick out their own car that they'll use to cruise. The new game looks like it will have the most engaging car-customization system in "GTA" history, but some fans are worried that the best customization features will end up locked behind a paywall — something "Need for Speed" players fought against with the 2017 release.
The "GTA 6" Ultimate Edition costs $100 and comes with exclusive in-game content. Some of those bonuses are what gamers have come to expect from new game add-ons, like weapons, cars, and cosmetics. The upgraded version of "GTA 6" also comes with access to a handful of exclusive in-game stores, including the only car-customization shops confirmed to be in the game at the time of this writing. Rideout Customs and One-Eyed Willie's offer a range of cosmetic and performance upgrades for vehicles, but those offers are currently only valid for gamers with the "GTA 6" Ultimate Edition.
Fans have been debating the merits of the Ultimate Edition online ever since it was announced, and many complain that the bonus content seems so central to the game that Ultimate Edition upgrade is really a mandatory purchase. articles.t: Xbox’s GTA 6 Deal With Rockstar Games Extends “Beyond Just the Cloud” – Rumor
articles.chapeau: The "new long-term Xbox publisher license agreement" seemingly entails more than just Cloud Gaming, per The Verge's Tom Warren.
articles.txt:
While previous reports indicating that Xbox had signed some long-term deal with Rockstar Games for Grand Theft Auto 6 were dismissed as a “nothing burger,” according to The Verge’s Tom Warren, a new social media post by Xbox CEO Asha Sharma indicates that there might be more to it. Sharma said that the availability of Grand Theft Auto 6 through Xbox Cloud Gaming from day one is “the first step” in the 10-year “strategic partnership” between the two companies.
“Today marks the first step in our new 10-year strategic partnership with Take-Two. GTA 6 , already the most pre-ordered game ever on Microsoft Store, will be playable on Xbox One through cloud gaming when it launches on November 19.” Warren has followed this post up with his own, noting that this deal extends beyond just Xbox Cloud Gaming. When asked about other details, Warren noted that he “thought it would be really obvious that ‘a new long-term Xbox publisher license agreement’ goes beyond just cloud.”
Xbox and Rockstar Games announced that Grand Theft Auto 6 would be available to play through Xbox Cloud Gaming. As part of the announcement, Xbox also confirmed that players who haven’t upgraded to an Xbox Series X/S and are still using Xbox One can experience Rockstar’s upcoming title as long as they buy it through Microsoft’s store. This doesn’t extend to PC, and fans of the platform will still have to wait until Rockstar officially announces a port.
Grand Theft Auto 6 is making its way to PS5 and Xbox Series X/S on November 19th. Leading up to this, Rockstar and Take-Two have kicked off heavy marketing, including an entire music festival slated for shortly after the title’s release. As for cloud access, PS5 users will have a more limited version through Remote Play on a PlayStation Portal and other supported devices.
In the meantime, CEO of Rockstar’s parent company, Take-Two Interactive, Strauss Zelnick, has also been teasing the studio’s future . Praising its work on GTA 6 , Zelnick said that “Rockstar will focus on what comes next,” which would be announced “in the fullness of time.”
On the subject of pre-order performance, Zelnick has been cagey about revealing any official figures. However, he has said that the title has been “running far in excess of our expectations.” This comes down to the fact that the company doesn’t want to “claim success before it occurs. So we’re just days away from beginning to see the fruits of our labor.”
Estimates from analytics firm Sensor Tower indicate that the title has already generated $1 billion through pre-order sales alone , thanks to more than 7.5 million copies having been sold across both platforms. PS5 has reportedly accounted for 75 percent of sales, with Xbox making up the remaining 25 percent.

articles.t: GTA 6 pourrait finalement tourner à 60 FPS grâce à cette nouvelle astuce
articles.chapeau: Annoncé à 30 FPS sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S, GTA 6 fait déjà débat chez les joueurs les plus exigeants. Un réglage discret sur certaines TV promet pourtant une fluidité façon 60 FPS.
articles.txt:
Annoncé à 30 FPS sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S, GTA 6 fait déjà débat chez les joueurs les plus exigeants. Un réglage discret sur certaines TV promet pourtant une fluidité façon 60 FPS.
GTA 6 arrive enfin sur consoles, mais la confirmation d’un ciblage à 30 FPS seulement sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S a fait grincer beaucoup de dents. Ceux qui ont investi dans une PS5 Pro et un téléviseur 120 Hz espéraient clairement un mode 60 FPS natif.
Une astuce venue des possesseurs de TV Samsung commence pourtant à circuler : grâce à un réglage caché, certains joueurs affirment que les jeux 30 FPS, dont GTA 6 , peuvent paraître bien plus proches du 60 FPS. Avec quelques limites importantes à connaître avant de toucher aux menus.
Rockstar Games a confirmé que Grand Theft Auto VI cible 30 FPS sur consoles, même sur PS5 Pro, sans garantir pour l’instant de mode Performance 60 FPS. Le jeu sort le 19 novembre 2026 et mise clairement sur les détails graphiques plutôt que sur la fluidité maximale.
Techniquement, 30 FPS signifie qu’une nouvelle image est calculée toutes les 33,3 ms. Sur une TV 60 Hz, chaque image est affichée deux fois, ce qui peut rester assez régulier si le framerate ne chute pas. Mais pour les joueurs habitués à 60 ou 120 FPS, surtout sur un écran OLED très réactif, les saccades deviennent vite difficiles à ignorer.
L’astuce vient d’un message de l’utilisateur @jotmanjotman sur X, devenu viral après l’annonce des 30 FPS. Il explique : « Les TV Samsung ont un réglage Game Motion Plus qui fait paraître les jeux 30 FPS comme du 60. Je l’ai utilisé sur RDR2, et ça a tout changé ». Ce réglage est disponible sur les modèles QLED et OLED récents de la marque.
Concrètement, Game Motion Plus applique une interpolation de mouvement : la console envoie toujours 30 images par seconde, mais le téléviseur calcule des images intermédiaires pour lisser l’animation. Résultat, les panoramiques et la conduite paraissent plus fluides, proches d’un 60 FPS visuel, même si le framerate réel ne bouge pas d’un poil.
Sur une TV Samsung compatible, il faut rester en Mode Jeu , puis ouvrir le sous-menu dédié au mouvement, où apparaît Game Motion Plus . L’idée est de commencer avec une intensité faible, histoire de gagner un peu de fluidité sans transformer l’image ni créer trop d’artefacts ou d’effet « soap opera ». D’autres marques proposent des équivalents, comme TruMotion chez LG ou MotionFlow chez Sony, mais ils sont souvent plus agressifs et peuvent être désactivés en Mode Jeu.
Attention toutefois au prix à payer : chaque traitement vidéo ajoute de l’input lag, c’est à dire un délai entre la pression sur la manette et l’action à l’écran. Pour un jeu solo narratif comme GTA 6 ou Red Dead Redemption 2 , beaucoup de joueurs accepteront ce compromis. En revanche, pour du multijoueur compétitif, mieux vaut garder un 30 FPS brut, avec le moins de retard possible.
Le bon réflexe est de tester l’astuce dès maintenant sur un jeu 30 FPS comme GTA 5 ou RDR2 . Si le « faux 60 FPS » vous convient, vous serez prêt pour Vice City dès la sortie. Sinon, il faudra espérer un futur mode Performance sur console ou attendre la version PC pour un vrai 60 FPS, voire plus, selon votre configuration.

articles.t: GTA 6 Boss’ Official Pre-Order Update Is Pretty Concerning
articles.chapeau: The numbers might not tell the whole story.
articles.txt:
By Sharmila Ganguly Published Nov 12, 2026, 5:00 PM EST Sharmila is an engineer-turned-gaming hardware journalist and freelance contributor at ScreenRant who has been covering the gaming and tech industry since 2021. While she first built her expertise writing about video games, she has since pivoted towards gaming hardware, with a focus on PC components, peripherals, handhelds, and performance-driven tech. When she’s not testing gear or writing about the latest hardware trends, she can usually be found diving into competitive shooters or keeping up with the evolving esports scene. Sign in to your ScreenRant account There’s a strange problem with having the most anticipated game in years on the way: even an enormous pre-order total may not tell its publisher what the launch day may look like. Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick has confirmed that Grand Theft Auto 6 pre-orders are running well ahead of the company’s expectations. As much as that sounds like good news, the details behind the update leave a few questions unanswered.
Speaking during Take-Two’s fiscal second-quarter earnings call on November 9, Zelnick said pre-orders were “tracking far in excess” of the company’s initial expectations. President Karl Slatoff also described the level of pre-orders as “extraordinary.” However, neither executive shared an exact figure, leaving fans and investors without an official count of how many copies have been reserved.
Lucia in a getaway in GTA 6 . The closest thing to a number comes from Sensor Tower , which, as of November 12, reports 11.27 million units sold. That is an estimate, not a figure confirmed by Rockstar or Take-Two, and it should not be mistaken for a final sales count. Reuters also reported a Sensor Tower estimate that nearly 90% of pre-orders recorded by late August were for the $99.99 Ultimate Edition , compared with $79.99 for the standard edition in the US. This suggests that many early buyers were willing to pay more, although the figures only describe pre-orders at that point in time.
The reason Take-Two is careful with the numbers is worth noting. In an earlier interview with Bloomberg , Zelnick said the company did not know whether the unusually high pre-order total could predict launch sales. Some customers might simply be buying earlier than they otherwise would have, and pre-orders can be canceled. He argued that releasing raw figures without understanding that behavior could give investors the wrong impression. High pre-order sales are encouraging , but they don't guarantee how the game will perform once it is available.
Take-Two expects net bookings of $3.35 billion to $3.5 billion for the quarter ending December 31, with GTA 6 expected to drive much of that result. Reuters noted that the forecast sits just below analysts’ average estimate of $3.51 billion. The company also reported second-quarter net bookings of $1.60 billion, down 18% from a year earlier and below the $1.67 billion analysts had expected. Take-Two has nevertheless kept its full-year net bookings forecast at $8 billion to $8.2 billion.
Grand Theft Auto 6 is scheduled to launch on November 19 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, according to Rockstar’s official website. With the release date now just around the corner, pre-order numbers are likely to climb further. Strong pre-launch demand is hardly a concern for Take-Two, but these numbers alone cannot tell us how the game will be received or how well it will sustain sales in the months that follow. That will only become clear once players finally get their hands on it.

articles.t: GTA 6 Gameplay Clips Circulate 7 Days Before Launch [2026]
articles.chapeau: New GTA 6 gameplay clips circulate a week before the Nov. 19 launch. What Rockstar confirmed, what stays unverified, and what to expect.
articles.txt:
With seven days left on the calendar before Grand Theft Auto VI arrives on November 19, 2026, new GTA 6 gameplay clips are circulating online. Happy Gamer reports that the footage has spread across social platforms, and the item that drew the most attention came from an account called Only in Dade . It appears to show a drive along Ocean Drive. Rockstar Games reposted it to its Instagram story and liked the original post.
That repost is the whole story, and it is also where the confirmed facts stop. Rockstar has not issued a statement calling the clip a new gameplay release, and the footage is too unclear to settle who is behind the camera. Readers who followed the earlier GTA 6 build leak coverage will recognize the pattern: a lot of noise, a small core of verified information, and a launch date that does not move.
This analysis separates what is confirmed from what is circulating. It covers what Rockstar has officially put out, what the Ocean Drive clip does and does not show, how the launch is structured on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, and what the final week probably looks like for players, retailers, and anyone chasing a click. Every specific claim below traces to the named outlets or to Rockstar’s own pages. Where the record is silent, the article says so.
Google · Preferred Sources Don't miss new tech stories on Google
Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.
The sequence is simple. Footage appeared online that viewers took to be new Grand Theft Auto VI material. Happy Gamer framed it as the top gaming story of the moment and tied it to the approaching launch. The most specific item came from Only in Dade , which posted what looks like a drive along Ocean Drive. Rockstar Games then reposted that video to its Instagram story and liked the post.
Those two actions from the publisher’s own account are the strongest signal in the record. A repost to a brand’s story is a deliberate act, and a like is a lighter but still visible one. Neither is a press release. Fans read them as a wink. A careful reporter reads them as a data point that is consistent with the footage being genuine, but not as proof of anything specific about how it was made or where it came from.
The word clips, plural, also deserves a pause. The record names one clip with enough detail to describe. Reports of additional clips exist in the general conversation, but no other single video carries the same documented chain of a named poster plus a Rockstar reaction. This article treats the Ocean Drive video as the anchor and everything else as unverified chatter.
Start with the solid ground. Rockstar Games is the developer and publisher named in official materials, and the release date is November 19, 2026. The platforms are PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Both PlayStation and Xbox list the launch at midnight local time on November 19, which means players in different time zones will get the game at different real-world moments as midnight rolls across the globe.
Digital pre-load is also confirmed. It opened on November 10, 2026. On PlayStation 5 it started at midnight local time, and on Xbox Series X|S it started globally at 12:00 a.m. GMT. That detail matters for this story because pre-load is the stage where a lot of players first touch the game’s files, and where a lot of leak chatter tends to multiply.
On the footage side, Rockstar’s PlayStation page says An Extended Look was captured entirely from in-game footage on PlayStation 5. That is the official benchmark for how the publisher wants the game to look in motion. Any circulating clip gets measured against it. The record includes no confirmed price, no confirmed technical specifications, and no on-record quote from a named speaker, so this piece leaves all three out rather than guess.
The clip is short on provenance and long on speculation. Only in Dade posted video that appears to show a drive along Ocean Drive. The wording from the reporting is careful: it appears to show that. Nobody in the cited record claims to have authenticated the video frame by frame, and the footage was described as too unclear to establish finer details.
Poor clarity cuts two ways. It makes the clip easy to dismiss, since low-quality footage is a hallmark of both real leaks and quick fakes. It also makes the clip easy to over-read, because viewers fill in blanks with what they hope to see. A blurry car, a bright street, and a camera that moves like someone filming

articles.t: YouTube to host 24-hour GTA 6 release date livestream with launch day gameplay
articles.chapeau: On the GTA 6 release date, gamers unable to play the Rockstar title can watch a 24-hour YouTube livestream. The video-sharing platform has enlisted content creators to showcase single-player gameplay. In the long run, the anticipated online mode may attract even more viewership.
articles.txt:
The GTA 6 release date should give streaming platforms a massive boost. To celebrate, YouTube has organized a 24-hour livestream dedicated to the launch . Starting at midnight EST on November 19th, audiences will see around 30 content creators explore the Leonida map for the first time.
For fans in many parts of the world, the Rockstar title unlocks even before the YouTube event kicks off. New Zealanders with GTA 6 preloads can access the game at midnight local time, which is 6 AM EST on November 18th. In Germany and other parts of Europe, the show airs 6 hours after some fans begin playing.
To prepare viewers for the 24-hour stream, the RDCWorld collective will host a pre-show at 11 PM EST. Besides gameplay , there will also be live reporting in Miami , where a massive marketing campaign is underway. Expected content creators include Jake Baldino, Cinna, Jelly, Rivers, Caylus, and Zhong.
In a blog post , YouTube highlighted how the Grand Theft Auto franchise has already generated over 900 billion views. Leading up to the GTA 6 release date, the company estimates that videos for the latest Rockstar project have produced over 40 billion views. That number is poised to grow once the game unlocks, but many broadcasters are looking more forward to a GTA Online sequel.
Twitch CEO Dan Clancy hinted an online mode would be ready in 2027. If the GTA 5 pattern repeats, possible role-playing content will prove the most popular. A Hatchet study found that over half of views in 2026 were for this creative spin on multiplayer.
Fortunately for streamers, single-player gameplay should keep fans occupied for weeks, if not months. The map of Vice City and surrounding regions is considerably larger than the previous Grand Theft Auto . Rockstar North ’s Rob Nelson said the Jason and Lucia campaign , plus optional objectives, took him roughly 80 hours to complete.

That viral Only in Dade video showing luxury cars along Miami Beach's Ocean Drive? It's actually part of a simulation.
Only in Dade shared the clip, but the footage appears to come from the upcoming Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6).

The House of GTA 6 account , which is not affiliated with Rockstar Games, shared the footage alongside real-life video reportedly used as inspiration for the game, offering a side-by-side comparison that's hard to believe.

View this post on Instagram The repost wasn't a confirmation, but it wasn't a denial, either.
On Oct. 16, Chopper 6 captured aerial footage of luxury cars that had been modified to resemble vehicles featured in GTA 6 as they made their way through the Magic City.

articles.txt:
Rockstar Games has amped up its marketing efforts for the release of Grand Theft Auto 6 on November 19th. A new social media account – dubbed “Only in Dade” – has been spotted that seemingly includes gameplay footage from the upcoming title. The footage features the iconic Vice City street Ocean Drive and a host of cars that people are looking at. In the background, another person is recording a similar video from a different perspective on the sidewalk.
While this initially raised concerns about whether the footage was AI-generated, Rockstar Games confirmed it’s in-game footage by reposting it to its own Instagram story. In another twist, the video was seemingly recreating real-world footage from last week. The original video involved Rockstar Games working with West Coast Customs to recreate the game’s cars in the real world. This, along with the fact that Only in Dade’s footage used a song from Grand Theft Auto 6: The Album , reveals this is part of an elaborate marketing strategy.
Grand Theft Auto 6 is shaping up to be one of the biggest video game launches in the industry. Recent data from analytics firm Sensor Tower indicated that the title has already crossed $1 billion in revenue through pre-orders alone, with over 10 million reported sales across PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. The split has heavily favored PlayStation, which has reportedly accounted for 75 percent of pre-orders so far (roughly 7.73 million copies), while Xbox has accounted for 25 percent (roughly 2.58 million copies).
Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick has also spoken about Rockstar Games’ future. Praising the company’s work during a recent earnings call, Zelnick teased what the studio might be working on .
“Rockstar has completed the development of GTA 6 . That may not come as a surprise to you, since we’re 10 days away from the release. They have done their very best work, and it’s going to come to consumers soon. They’re in the middle of their marketing campaign, which also, unsurprisingly, is fully baked. At this point, it’s the job of the organization to make sure that we do an A+ job, technically, in delivering this product to consumers.”
“Then, of course, Rockstar will focus on what comes next, and they’ll announce that in the fullness of time.”
It is currently unknown whether Grand Theft Auto 6 will get its own version of GTA Online later, since Rockstar itself has been quiet about the matter. However, the studio may be working on a new version. How it migrates the current iteration’s massive player base also remains to be seen.

articles.t: GTA 6 sur Xbox One passe par le cloud, et le Game Pass est la porte la plus chère
articles.chapeau: Les possesseurs de Xbox One pourront jouer à GTA 6 dès sa sortie, mais uniquement en streaming, avec les réglages de la Xbox Series S, et chaque heure est décom
articles.txt:
Ajoutez-nous sur Google Grand Theft Auto VI tournera sur une console mise en vente il y a plus de dix ans. À strictement parler, il n’y tournera pas du tout. Les possesseurs de Xbox One ne pourront jouer à GTA VI que sous la forme d’un flux vidéo envoyé depuis les serveurs de Microsoft , calculé avec les réglages graphiques de la Xbox Series S, la vieille machine étant réduite à un écran et une manette. Xbox l’a annoncé sur Xbox Wire, et Rockstar Games l’a confirmé dans ses propres notes de lancement.
C’est un accès réel pour les joueurs qui n’ont jamais changé de console, et Microsoft mérite d’être salué pour cela. Mais ce lancement devient aussi le premier grand test du Xbox Cloud Gaming en tant que service au compteur. Les abonnements Game Pass incluent désormais une ration fixe d’heures de streaming, et Microsoft vend du temps supplémentaire en packs prépayés. Faites le calcul pour quelqu’un qui possède l’ancienne console et ne veut que GTA VI : l’abonnement perd, et de loin. Sur une vieille machine, la porte d’entrée du jeu de Rockstar n’est pas le Game Pass. C’est le compteur.
L’annonce de Xbox est brève et précise. Grand Theft Auto VI, que Microsoft présente comme le titre le plus précommandé de tous les temps sur sa boutique, sera jouable via Xbox Cloud Gaming sur Xbox One et sur Xbox Series X|S dès le jour de sa sortie. La version en streaming utilise les réglages graphiques de la Xbox Series S, quelle que soit la console qui la reçoit. Les propriétaires d’une Series X ou d’une Series S pourront toujours installer le jeu et le faire tourner en natif. Ceux de l’ancienne machine, non : aucune version du jeu n’existe pour elle, et le flux reste donc leur seule voie.
Le streaming ouvre à 1 h du matin, heure de l’Est américain, le 19 novembre, jour de la sortie ; Mixed a insisté sur le fait qu’il s’agit de l’heure de début du flux, pas d’une sortie anticipée. L’accès au cloud n’inclut pas l’achat du jeu. Aux États-Unis, cela signifie 79,99 dollars pour la Standard Edition ou 99,99 dollars pour l’Ultimate Edition, les prix relevés par Windows Central à l’ouverture des précommandes. La note de Rockstar, citée par Dexerto, contient l’avertissement qui vaut pour tout jeu dans le cloud : « la vitesse de connexion et d’autres facteurs techniques peuvent influer sur les performances du jeu d’une manière qui n’affecterait pas une partie en local ».
Asha Sharma , directrice générale de Xbox, a présenté la nouvelle comme dépassant le cadre d’un seul jeu. « Aujourd’hui marque la première étape de notre nouveau partenariat stratégique de 10 ans avec Take-Two », a-t-elle écrit sur X, avant d’ajouter que GTA VI « sera jouable sur XBOX One via le cloud gaming lors de sa sortie le 19 novembre ». Microsoft affirme que GTA V, Red Dead Redemption 2 et d’autres titres Rockstar rejoindront le service dans les mois à venir. Pure Xbox a fait remarquer que Sharma n’a donné aucun détail sur le contenu de ce partenariat.
Le piège est arrivé avant le jeu. Microsoft a annoncé en septembre que le Game Pass cesserait d’offrir un streaming illimité dans le cloud, et les plafonds s’appliquent désormais : cinq heures par mois avec Game Pass Essential, dix avec Premium et quinze avec Ultimate. Tech Times, citant Windows Central, situe ces formules à 9,99, 14,99 et 22,99 dollars par mois. L’explication de Microsoft, rapportée par Game Developer et Pure Xbox, était sans détour : « le coût de fourniture du cloud gaming augmente à mesure que davantage de personnes l’utilisent et jouent plus longtemps ».
Le temps supplémentaire s’achète en packs Cloud Playtime, que Microsoft facture à des prix de lancement : 3,99 dollars pour 10 heures, 7,99 pour 25 et 11,99 pour 50. Les heures achetées n’expirent pas, et elles ne valent que pour les jeux que le joueur possède. À partir du 11 novembre, selon Xbox Wire, les joueurs des marchés pris en charge peuvent acheter ce temps de jeu sans le moindre abonnement Game Pass.
Mettez les deux côte à côte, et l’arithmétique penche nettement d’un côté. Chaque heure de streaming incluse dans Game Pass Ultimate revient à environ 1,53 dollar, et à environ 2 dollars avec Essential. Les packs coûtent entre 24 et 40 cents de l’heure, la fourchette calculée par Ars Technica. Virgin Media O2 a interrogé des joueurs britanniques, qui comptent passer en moyenne 17 heures sur GTA VI pendant sa première semaine. articles.t: "Ce qui se passe chez Rockstar dépasse les murs du studio": à une semaine de la sortie de "GTA 6", les salariés du studio sont appelés à voter pour se syndiquer
articles.chapeau: La sortie de "Grand Theft Auto VI", l'un des jeux vidéo les plus attendus de tous les temps, pourrait se faire alors que les développeurs anglais du studio Rockstar se syndiquent. Une demande de longue date après plusieurs scandales internes.
articles.txt:
Plus de 1.600 salariés britanniques de Rockstar Games, le créateur de Grand Theft Auto , sont appelés à voter à partir de jeudi sur la reconnaissance d'un syndicat, à une semaine de la sortie de GTA VI et de la fin d'un procès sur une vingtaine de licenciements.
Le vote porte sur un accord négocié depuis quatre mois entre la direction et les employés du studio, visant à reconnaître le syndicat Rockstar Game Workers Union, a expliqué dans un communiqué l'IWGB (Independent Workers' Union of Great Britain), dont il fait partie.
En cas de feu vert, ce syndicat deviendrait le plus important reconnu dans le secteur du jeu vidéo au Royaume-Uni, selon cette source.
La consultation se tient jusqu'au 26 novembre, quelques jours après le lancement particulièrement attendu du sixième opus de GTA le 19 novembre.
Rockstar Games se défend actuellement devant la justice en Ecosse, berceau de la franchise GTA , d'avoir licencié 23 salariés en octobre 2025 en raison de leur activité syndicale .
Les plaignants affirment qu'ils étaient sur le point d'atteindre le seuil de 10% d'adhérents au syndicat, nécessaire à sa reconnaissance au sein de l'entreprise.
L'entreprise américaine les accuse d'avoir partagé des informations confidentielles, y compris concernant GTA 6 , sur des canaux de discussion non sécurisés sur la plateforme Discord.
"Nous tenons profondément aux jeux que nous créons, et nous voulons nous assurer que nous pourrons continuer à faire ce travail dans un environnement où nous sommes respectés , où nous avons notre mot à dire de manière significative sur nos conditions (de travail) et pouvons nous sentir sereins quant à notre avenir", a déclaré Nestor Uriate, programmeur en animation et représentant du Rockstar Game Workers Union, dans un commentaire joint au communiqué.
L'accord "établirait un cadre permettant aux travailleurs de négocier les salaires, y compris les heures supplémentaires et les primes, ainsi que les congés et les retraites, et leur donnerait des droits de consultation sur les politiques de ressources humaines et l'utilisation de l'IA", précise l'IWGB.
"Ce qui se passe chez Rockstar dépasse les murs du studio", et concerne l'ensemble de l'industrie, a pour sa part commenté Alex Marshall, président de l'IWGB.
D'autres syndicats, notamment le puissant SAG-AFTRA réunissant acteurs et professionnels du monde du cinéma, de la télé et des jeux vidéo, ainsi que le CWA affilié au développeur et éditeur de jeux Blizzard, ont apporté leur soutien à cette reconnaissance.
L'entreprise a également renvoyé à des propos tenus mi-octobre auprès de Bloomberg . "Nous suivons la volonté de l'équipe", avait alors déclaré la responsable de l'édition du studio Jennifer Kolbe. "Donc si (les employés, NDLR) veulent un syndicat, ils auront un syndicat."

articles.chapeau: À quelques jours de la sortie de GTA 6, un corner Rockstar chez Selfridges Manchester laisse apparaître un morceau de la carte de Leonida. Sept noms surgissent, et ils rebattraient les cartes du futur monde ouvert.
articles.txt:
À quelques jours de la sortie de GTA 6, un corner Rockstar chez Selfridges Manchester laisse apparaître un morceau de la carte de Leonida. Sept noms surgissent, et ils rebattraient les cartes du futur monde ouvert.
Une nouvelle fuite de la carte de Grand Theft Auto VI surgit là où on ne l’attendait pas : au cœur d’un événement officiel de Rockstar Games , dans le magasin Selfridges Manchester . Sur une affiche de la collection Goodtime State – Vice City Collection , des visiteurs ont réussi à capturer un coin de la map de Leonida derrière une vitre.
Résultat : sept nouveaux noms de lieux sont lisibles sur cette portion de carte de GTA 6 , offrant un aperçu plus précis de la structure du monde ouvert . Alors que Rockstar évite toujours de montrer la carte complète, cette fuite venue de son propre dispositif marketing relance les spéculations sur la taille et la diversité de Leonida.
Depuis le 9 novembre, Rockstar a installé des corners GTA 6 dans plusieurs Selfridges britanniques, dont Manchester, pour exposer la Goodtime State – Vice City Collection , un coffret de merchandising autour de 399,99 dollars (environ 370 €). À l’intérieur, un poster double face inclut au verso ce que Rockstar décrit comme une vue complète de la carte de Leonida.
À Manchester, ce poster était partiellement visible, plié et placé derrière une vitre. Des fans ont zoomé sur les photos, puis partagé les recadrages sur les réseaux sociaux. Comme le rapporte ComicBook, on distingue clairement des toponymes, un panneau routier « Toll 1A » et même un dirigeable, autant d’éléments qui laissent penser à un véritable asset de jeu plutôt qu’à un simple concept art.
Sept noms inédits apparaissent sur cette portion de carte : Goose Key , Pelican Valley , Lummox County , Manzana , Moreau , Key Lento et Southwind . Goose Key, Key Lento et Southwind s’inscrivent clairement dans l’archipel des Leonida Keys , au sud de Vice City , inspiré des Florida Keys. On peut y attendre zones portuaires, petites communautés isolées et beaucoup de déplacements en bateau.
Pelican Valley semble pointer vers la région marécageuse de Grassrivers , proche des Everglades, avec un terrain idéal pour des poursuites en airboat ou des missions d’infiltration dans les mangroves. Plus au nord, Manzana et Moreau renvoient sans doute à des villes ou districts reliés à des régions comme Port Gellhorn ou Ambrosia , renforçant l’idée d’un hinterland dense au delà de la côte.
Le cas le plus intéressant reste Lummox County . Ce comté n’existait jusqu’ici que sur la controverse CYBERLEEK , une carte complète non officielle largement débattue. Le voir imprimé sur la carte du collector exposée par Rockstar crédibilise fortement son intégration dans la version finale, même s’il faut garder une part de prudence tant que rien n’est explicitement confirmé.
Rockstar a déjà indiqué que Leonida sera sa plus grande carte à ce jour , environ deux fois plus vaste que celle de GTA 5 et jusqu’à trois fois Red Dead Redemption 2 , tout en restant plus dense. Ces nouveaux noms confirment la diversité promise entre mégalopole de Vice City, archipel tropical, marais de Grassrivers et comtés intérieurs comme Lummox.
Comme pour Red Dead Redemption 2 , il est peu probable que Rockstar publie la carte complète avant la sortie mondiale de Grand Theft Auto VI , prévue le 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 , Xbox Series X et Xbox Series S , au prix d’au moins 80 dollars (environ 75 €). En Europe, les éditions boîtes ne devraient pas inclure de carte papier ; Rockstar proposera plutôt un poster numérique gratuit au lancement. D’ici là, la fuite de Selfridges reste le meilleur aperçu tangible de la map de Leonida, à prendre malgré tout avec quelques pincettes.

articles.t: « On a pété tous les scores » : la sortie de GTA 6 bouscule ce Micromania près de Morlaix
Le plus grand enjeu de GTA 6, c'est de savoir raconter l'amour
articles.chapeau: Quand Cupidon braque des cœurs
articles.txt:
Le poids sur les épaules de Rockstar est immense. Tel est le destin de celui qui fabrique « le jeu vidéo le plus attendu de l'histoire », avec toutes les dérives industrielles et sociétales que cela engendre. Mais pourquoi l'attend-on, au juste ? L'envergure de l'expérience est telle que chacun y trouvera sa motivation personnelle ; officiellement, la promesse du studio est visiblement de dépeindre, encore et toujours, la société américaine au travers du crime organisé. Peut-être, néanmoins, que la véritable portée du récit est ailleurs avec, en ligne de mire, les histoires de cœur plutôt que le récit des armes.
Grand Theft Auto , c'est avant tout une fresque satirique d'une ampleur colossale. Les États-Unis sont un merveilleux sujet de société dont il est facile d'accentuer les qualités, les défauts, les pièges et les excentricités. Bien sûr, le crime et la tentation de l'interdit ont permis à Rockstar d'y apporter du fun et parfois un côté délirant, au gré d'un gameplay qui a permis l'accessibilité et fait le bonheur du grand public. Du jetpack, du katana, des piétons bousculés, des courses-poursuites interminables avec des flics, des tanks, juste parce que. Et puis, on vieillit. Ces possibilités politiquement incorrectes ne sont peut-être plus aussi drôles qu'avant, et GTA 5 en a pourtant exploité la moindre miette pendant treize longues années. Difficile aussi de continuer à ronger ce même squelette après la noirceur d'un GTA IV , boudé par beaucoup à l'époque, qui se servait enfin du crime pour le condamner sous toutes ses formes, et pas pour le glorifier.
GTA VI , au-delà de tous les espoirs les plus fous concernant la vivacité de son monde ouvert, de sa technique, de ses graphismes, de sa bande-son, de ses gunfights , c'est aussi et surtout le premier jeu de la saga qui affiche un couple sur sa jaquette. Jason et Lucia sont les chefs d'orchestre d'une trame rythmée par les braquages, les vols, l'extorsion et les jobs décrochés auprès d'une clientèle sordide, mais haute en couleur. Sur la forme, c'est la danse habituelle des GTA : au travers des actes illégaux et de l'attrait de l'argent facile, Rockstar veut dépeindre une Floride essorée par l'idéologie ultracapitaliste des États-Unis, de ses habitants ultra-conservateurs, de quelques ultra-progressistes et de tous ceux qui en profitent pour gagner du terrain. Sauf que, voilà : difficile d'écrire une satire pertinente quand le pays ciblé se veut déjà sa propre parodie, sombrant depuis des années dans une violence décomplexée. Regarder les infos américaines, que ce soit à la télévision ou sur les réseaux sociaux, c'est déjà assister à un épisode de South Park grandeur nature, où la triste réalité trempe dans l'absurde, le sang et le non-sens. Il va être très difficile pour Rockstar d'en accentuer les contours pour critiquer les USA subtilement, surtout dans un jeu qui tourne le potard du réalisme au maximum. Un sujet que Kyujilo a déjà bien couvert sur la capacité de GTA 6 à choquer .
Mais peut-être, finalement, que le véritable cheval de bataille se trouve autour de la relation de Jason et Lucia. Peut-être que là où Rockstar nous prendra aux tripes, nous fera chialer, nous mettra des étoiles dans les yeux, c'est dans l'amour et le flirt plutôt que dans les billets verts et une grosse bagnole carjackée. Peut-être que le plus gros impact scénaristique que l'on retiendra de GTA 6 , ce sera la dévotion que l'un mettra dans l'autre, et réciproquement. Il n'y a finalement que le Rockstar d'aujourd'hui qui peut le faire, celui qui s'est fait la main au travers de tant de GTA et surtout sur l'émotionnel Red Dead Redemption II . Pour rappel, la relation des deux héros dépendra surtout du joueur et de sa volonté à la consolider ou non. Visiblement, il sera même possible de ne pas être en couple , et cela aura un impact sur l'histoire. Pour nourrir son amour, il faudra donner du sien : faire des activités, prendre soin de l'autre, lui envoyer des messages, lui répondre, mais aussi s'atteler à des missions criminelles ensemble car après tout, frôler la mort à deux, ça rapproche terriblement.

articles.t: GTA 6 map leak from the Collector's Box shows new locations
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 map leak: photos of the printed Leonida map from the Collector's Box are circulating online, first spotted at a Selfridges display in Manchester.
articles.txt:
Photos of the stylised poster, first spotted at a Selfridges display in Manchester, name places such as Port Gellhorn and Goose Key. Rockstar hasn’t confirmed it.
0:00 A GTA 6 map leak has surfaced a week before launch. Photos of the printed Leonida map from Rockstar’s Collector’s Box are circulating online, and they reportedly show areas fans didn’t know about.
Rockstar hasn’t shared the map publicly, and standard physical copies of GTA 6 don’t include a printed one. Insider Gaming reports that the images are circulating and reveal “some areas we previously didn’t know about.” Nothing in them is confirmed.
Found us on Google? Add tbreak as a preferred source to see more of our stories in Top Stories.
Beebom counted “five major counties, 11 islands and keys, 13 towns and cities, and nine other named locations, including Grassrivers” on the leaked poster. It says the map “looks massive compared to previous GTA games”, with plenty of ground for Jason and Lucia to cover.
Vice City is there, of course, but the new names are the draw. Notebookcheck spotted Lummox County in the north, Moreau, and Pelican Valley in Grassrivers further south, as well as Goose Key in the southern section. Beebom adds Port Gellhorn and Ambrosia. Apart from some edges, such as the Leonida Keys, Notebookcheck says most regions and labels are visible.
The poster uses colour to mark the land: red for urban areas, yellow and orange for countryside, and green for wilderness, nature reserves, and zoos, according to egw.news.
Don’t treat the image as a satellite view, though. VGC’s report puts it this way:
Pictures coming out of the GTA 6 collection at Selfridges in London, England, show what appears to be a stylised version of the map used in GTA 6.
Insider Gaming goes further: “It’s not an accurate replication of the in-game map, most likely, but it’s what we have.” ComicBook also says the entire map hasn’t leaked, only a part of it.
The first photo came from X user @GazzaMontana, who snapped the box on display at the Selfridges store in Manchester’s Exchange Square. His post noted that the store had the Collectors Set on display with the map folded up inside it. He wrote that “this means somebody who works there has seen it fully”.
VGC reports that the clearest image reportedly came from an Instagram account that has since been deleted. Insider Gaming says someone has claimed the image came from a Selfridges employee, but nobody has confirmed it. Selfridges hosted a GTA 6 takeover in partnership with Rockstar, and VGC says Selfridges doesn’t sell the box; it “appears to have simply been a display item.” RockstarINTEL’s sources, however, say the Manchester store had one box on sale and has since sold it.
A second stylised map is also circulating, and some fans think it’s the other side of the poster. VGC says it doesn’t have any other sources sharing that image, so it’s unconfirmed. Tbreak’s report on the box says the other side carries Macca the Gator artwork, but Beebom says that side hasn’t appeared in the leak yet.
The poster is one of 11 items in Rockstar’s Goodtime State – Vice City Collection , which costs $399.99 in the US and £349.99 in the UK. It’s merchandise, not a game edition, so buyers still need GTA 6 itself. The set also includes a six-inch Macca the Gator figure, Oakley Frogskins sunglasses, a New Era 9FORTY A-Frame hat, and a Leonida Keys crossbody bag. It will ship from 19 November 2026.
Players who skip the box won’t miss out for long. Notebookcheck says Rockstar will make a downloadable digital map available on or shortly after release day.
This all adds to what has been a marketing campaign full of leaks from start to finish.
VGC says the worst came from Cyberleek, which seemingly got hold of a playable build months before release and shared gameplay before Rockstar’s Netflix reveal. Cyberleek has since called off its full-build release .
GTA 6 will launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on 19 November, unlocking at 12am GST in the UAE. On the UAE PlayStation Store, the game costs AED 299.16 for Standard and AED 373.96 for Ultimate , and pre-loading opened on 10 November. In a week, players can check the leaked poster against the real Leonida.

articles.t: GTA 6 physical map leaks as Rockstar teases non-US sequel
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 continues the series tradition of purely US settings, featuring locations based on the real world state of Florida.
articles.txt:
The newly launched GTA 6 pop-up store in London has led to pics of GTA 6’s physical map leaking online before it’s available to purchase.
While GTA 6 has already sold over eight million copies in pre-orders alone, and is set to be the most successful entertainment launch of all time, it’s not gone without some frustrated complaints from fans.
The lack of a physical release is a big one, but fans are also upset that physical copies of GTA 6’s map need to be bought separately . That’s despite the fact that, in the past, GTA games have come bundled with a map as a free bonus.
There won’t be any map available until the game’s launch next week, on November 19, but fans already have an idea of what it looks like thanks to the Selfridges pop-up store that launched in London this week.
Photos from the store have been circulating online , which depict the map being displayed as part of GTA 6’s collector’s edition .
The display map is folded up so you can’t make out much, but a photo of what the map looks like when opened has also been shared on X. Exactly who took the initial photo and how isn’t clear, but it’s suspected to be an employee of the store.
Sign up to the GameCentral newsletter for the latest GTA 6 news, reviews of new games you should play and exclusive analysis of the biggest stories of the week.
Unlike past physical maps, which were detailed enough to the point where you could use them to help find your way in-game, GTA 6’s one is more stylised and only offers the general locations of important areas and how its various counties are divided.
That’s to be expected, though. Rockstar’s only selling the map for 99 cents (about 75p) and given how huge GTA 6’s map will be in-game, the physical version was never going to be that detailed.
As a reminder, Rockstar will be offering digital downloads of the map for free via the Rockstar Store and while you can buy it physically for less than a £1, it’ll come as a freebie with anything you purchase from the store.
Speaking of maps, there’s some renewed optimism for the GTA series breaking away from its US setting. In an interview with The Guardian , Rob Nelson, co-head of GTA 6 developer Rockstar North, was asked about the possibility of a future GTA game being set outside of the US.
‘Never say never,’ answered Nelson, but he did admit that there’s ‘still so much to do in America.’ It’s far too soon to say whether this means GTA 7 will take fans to a new, untouched corner of GTA’s version of the US or if it will return to past locales like Liberty City.
The latest GTA game has been a long time coming. (Picture: Metro/Grand Theft Auto)
After more than a decade of anticipation, Rockstar Games' highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on November 19, taking players back to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City.
Set in the sprawling state of Leonida, heavily inspired by Florida, the open world adventure follows dual protagonists Jason and Lucia in what promises to be the biggest and most immersive GTA game yet.
Still, even this vague answer is an interesting change of stance for the studio. Back when Rockstar North co-founder and GTA series writer Dan Houser was still there, he very much ruled out the possibility of GTA games being set anywhere else.
‘My own personal feeling is that GTA is America,’ Houser said in 2013 , ‘I think we would love to set a game in the UK, set in London, whatever, but I don’t know if it would be a GTA game.
‘I think there are plenty of great stories we could tell about the UK, great environments to showcase, great gameplay mechanics that could have a UK bent to them – I just don’t think it would be a GTA necessarily.’
Houser did make a good point as GTA has primarily satirised US culture and that same writing approach can’t simply be ported over to a GTA game set anywhere else.
There’s also the risk of alienating players. US culture is globally recognised, which can’t be said for most other countries. Even if it would be interesting to see the series mix up its setting, the simple fact is it’s not guaranteed to sell as well.
That’s not to say GTA hasn’t tried this before. The first game saw two London themed expansions, but these were long before the series became the cultural juggernaut it is today and they were simple mission packs with barely any narrative connecting them.

articles.t: GTA 6 Map Seemingly Leaks at Merch Drop Event
articles.chapeau: Grand Theft Auto 6's map appears to have leaked early due to a Selfridges event.
articles.txt:
With Grand Theft Auto 6 , Rockstar Games has already experienced some of the highest-profile leaks in gaming history, and it seems at least one more has snuck in before the game’s impending Nov. 19 release . Pictures are circulating of what appears to be a physical poster of GTA 6 ’s map .
“The Goodtime State,” the top of the map reads. This refers to Leonida, the game’s fictionalized rendition of Florida. The map shows various counties that make up the game, with cartoonish characters highlighting each area’s defining characteristics. Two souped-up cars are shown racing to the west in Cellhorn, while a lowrider and an engine are shown in Cronstown to the east. Leonard County has what appears to be a cowboy with assless chaps playing golf, while Mariana County seems like it will be full of gators and fish. And of course, there’s Vice City — the main locale of Rockstar’s 2002 GTA 3 follow-up — which will be one of the main locations in GTA 6.
The map appears to have leaked as part of the ongoing merch events at Selfridges stores in London. One user claimed that the map was shown in a display highlighting what will be included in GTA 6 ’s $399.99 Collector’s Box . Rockstar’s description of the box ( which doesn’t include a copy of the game ) lists a “Double-Sided Souvenir Poster with Map of Leonida.”
While the map shown in the display isn't entirely visible , the image above shows it unfurled, with one user speculating the picture “originated from a naughty Selfridges employee.” Another image posted on Reddit shows the backside of the map, which offers a topographical view of the fictional state.
Rockstar previously revealed that GTA 6 will let players freely explore Leonida beyond Vice City, where players can perform activities like kayaking, mini golf, street racing, jet skiing, parachuting, sunbathing, cave diving, nightclubbing, base-jumping, and more. The game has been in development for quite a while, with principal production extending back to 2018 after the launch of Red Dead Redemption 2. We've gone 13 years without a new Grand Theft Auto.
As you might expect, GTA 6 seems like it will be huge: Rockstar previously revealed that the game’s map is around three times larger than Red Dead Redemption 2 . One employee said that it took them around 80 hours to get through the game’s main story.

articles.chapeau: Hog wild
articles.txt:
With the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 mere days away, we already know to expect a whole lot of mature subject matter. Official promotional materials like the Netflix Extended Look have prominently featured strip clubs, drug deals gone wrong, and chaotic vehicular shootouts. A new report out of South Korea from Inven Global claims members of the Game Content Rating Board (GCRB) nearly refused to issue a rating for GTA 6 , which would have effectively banned the game there. The main sticking point? An excessive amount of "out of context genital nudity."
According to the report, the GCRB held three separate review sessions to determine its rating for GTA 6 . The first review took place on Sept. 10, before committee members had access to a playable build. That ended in a tie, with three voting in favor of refusal and three in favor of an Adults Only rating. "I do not believe genital exposure to this extent falls within acceptable limits under the current standard," said one of the members who refused a rating. It's possible that this assessment was shaped by the massive GTA 6 gameplay leaks that took place over the summer, which showed Jason interacting with unclothed patrons at a nudist resort and nonchalantly cruising around the streets of Miami with his dong hanging out .
The GCRB met again on Oct. 2, but ultimately opted to postpone its decision a second time, having obtained a copy of the game just a few days earlier. "Further inspection is necessary, but if a rating is actually granted, we should take this opportunity to review changing the regulation that treats simple genital exposure as grounds for refusal," said one of the committee members.
Image: Rockstar Games During the final review session on Oct. 16, the committee voted eight to one in favor of issuing an Adults Only (19+) rating. "It appears that they intentionally covered genital exposure in explicitly sexual scenes, while allowing exposure in background settings," explained one voter from the majority. The lone dissenter expressed concerns that this would mean open season on background penises in future games. "Suppose we consider genre characteristics to permit background genital exposure in adventures or RPGs while remaining conservative only with suggestive games," they said. "I am concerned that background genital exposure will frequently appear in future RPGs as a result." Don't get any ideas, Square Enix!
While it is pretty funny to imagine people having high-stakes debates about how much dong is too much dong for a video game, this conflict indirectly tells us some interesting things about GTA 6. We know there will "explicitly sexual scenes" in the game, but you won't see anyone's business district during those moments. In other words, Rockstar isn't bringing the infamous Hot Coffee sex minigame from GTA: San Andreas into 2026. That's probably for the best.
GTA 6 has received strict adult age classifications in virtually every market. It's got an M (17+) rating in North America, and 18+ ratings in Japan, Europe, the UK, Australia, New Zealand, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, South Africa, Taiwan, Thailand, and Brazil. The game has a 21+ rating in Saudi Arabia and the UAE. GTA 6 will be released on Nov. 19 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X.

articles.t: Leaked Collector’s Edition poster reveals most of Grand Theft Auto 6’s Leonida map
articles.chapeau: An Instagram unboxing of the $400 Goodtime State – Vice City Collection exposed a poster that shows most regions of Leonida ahead of the Grand Theft Auto 6 release.
articles.txt:
An Instagram unboxing of the $400 Goodtime State – Vice City Collection exposed a poster that shows most regions of Leonida ahead of the Grand Theft Auto 6 release.
An Instagram unboxing of the Goodtime State – Vice City Collection gave fans the most complete look yet at the Grand Theft Auto 6 map of Leonida.
Tex2 shared a now-deleted Instagram reel that displayed the unfolded poster included with the $400 Collector’s Edition. The image labels most regions and destinations across Rockstar Games’ open world. Lummox County sits in the north, with Moreau marked among its locations. Farther south, Pelican Valley appears in Grassrivers. The Leonida Keys remain among the few edge areas the poster does not show in full.
The map also includes details that connect to earlier footage. Toll roads appear on the print, matching a suggestion from the Netflix Extended Look trailer. A blimp icon marks another point of interest on the chart.
Before this leak, a display of the Collector’s Box at a Selfridges store in Manchester showed a folded version of the poster. That glimpse revealed Goose Key in the southern section of Leonida but left much of the state hidden. The new images fill in gaps that community trackers had tried to map from screenshots and trailers.
The release changes how buyers can access a physical map. Rockstar Games included printed maps in past titles such as Grand Theft Auto 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2, but standard physical copies of Grand Theft Auto 6 do not include one. Retail boxes contain a double-sided poster with cover art and the Bikini Girl image. Rockstar Games plans to make a downloadable digital map available on or shortly after release. Buyers who want the navigational poster must purchase the $400 Goodtime State – Vice City Collection.
The GTA 6 Mapping Project, a community effort to chart Vice City and Leonida from official material, reported a DMCA strike to its Discord server. Its website remains accessible. The group plans to compare its work with the details visible in the latest leak as players prepare for launch.
Source : Full GTA 6 map from Collector's Edition leaks, showing new parts of Leonida , by Adam Corsetti , Notebookcheck , Nov 12, 2026

articles.t: La carte de GTA 6 n’est plus un secret : une fuite inattendue révèle tout Leonida - Dexerto
articles.chapeau: La carte complète de GTA 6 aurait fuité accidentellement. Découvrez les nouvelles régions de Leonida révélées avant la sortie du jeu.
articles.txt:
GTA La carte de GTA 6 n’est plus un secret : une fuite inattendue révèle tout Leonida par Ludovic Quinson Publié : 12 nov. 2026, 15:30 Sauvegarder pour plus tard Sauvegarder pour plus tard Rockstar Games Ajouter comme source préférée sur Google Suivre sur Google News À une semaine de la sortie de GTA 6 , les joueurs pourraient bien avoir découvert l’un des derniers grands secrets que Rockstar cherchait à préserver. Alors que le studio n’a toujours pas dévoilé officiellement la carte de Leonida, plusieurs images circulant sur les réseaux sociaux permettraient désormais d’en découvrir l’intégralité.
Et contrairement aux nombreuses cartes imaginées par les fans ces dernières années, cette nouvelle fuite trouverait son origine dans un événement promotionnel organisé par Rockstar lui-même.
Attention, spoilers : la suite de cet article contient des informations potentiellement inédites sur la carte de GTA 6, notamment des noms de lieux et de régions que Rockstar n’a pas encore officiellement dévoilés.
Tout serait parti d’une exposition organisée dans le grand magasin Selfridges, à Manchester, au Royaume-Uni, où Rockstar présentait plusieurs objets liés à GTA 6. Parmi eux figurait une carte physique de Leonida, incluse dans l’édition Collector du jeu et exposée derrière une vitrine.
Selfridges in Manchester Exchange Square have got the #GTA6 Collectors Set on display and the Map folded up in the display too.. this means somebody who works there has seen it fully 👀 here what I snapped 😉 @RockstarGames #GTAVI pic.twitter.com/2qfyllsdqI
Si cette dernière n’était pas entièrement dépliée, certains visiteurs ont rapidement remarqué que plusieurs portions du territoire restaient visibles. Les premières photos ont ainsi permis d’identifier des lieux jusqu’alors inconnus, notamment Goose Key, Pelican Valley, Leonard County, Lummox County, Manzana, Moreau, Mariana County, Key Lento et Southwind. Un panneau indique également la route à péage Toll 1A ainsi qu’un dirigeable ont également été repérés sur les images.
BREAKING: GTA 6's Official Paper Map Revealed. pic.twitter.com/e8naxsUcGL
Mais l’histoire ne s’arrête pas là. Alors que seules quelques parties de la carte étaient initialement accessibles, une version présentée comme intégrale a depuis commencé à circuler sur Internet. De quoi offrir aux joueurs un aperçu beaucoup plus précis de la géographie de Leonida avant même de pouvoir explorer le jeu.
La taille de la carte de GTA 6 dévoilée, aussi vaste que trois jeux Rockstar réunis
GTA 6 pourrait accueillir Liberty City d’après une fuite de fichiers Rockstar
L’édition physique de GTA 6 pourrait inclure une carte collector de Leonida
Il convient néanmoins de rester prudent. Si la présence d’une carte physique lors de l’événement constitue l’origine rapportée de cette fuite, Rockstar n’a pas confirmé l’authenticité de toutes les images actuellement partagées.
Depuis les premières présentations de GTA 6, Rockstar a clairement montré que l’aventure de Jason et Lucia ne se limiterait pas aux rues de Vice City. La ville inspirée de Miami devrait certes occuper une place centrale dans l’histoire, mais les joueurs pourront également parcourir de nombreuses autres régions de Leonida, entre zones rurales, petites villes, marécages et archipels.
Les joueurs n’auront de toute façon plus longtemps à patienter puisque GTA 6 sera disponible le 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S.

articles.t: La carte de GTA 6 fuitée lors d'un drop de merchandising chez Selfridges
articles.txt:
Une potentielle carte de GTA 6 a été aperçue sur des produits dérivés officiels vendus chez Selfridges , le grand magasin londonien. Les images, rapidement diffusées sur les réseaux sociaux, montrent ce qui ressemble à une représentation détaillée du monde ouvert du prochain jeu de Rockstar Games. Si l’authenticité de cette carte reste à confirmer, elle a immédiatement enflammé la communauté des joueurs, avide de la moindre information sur ce titre très attendu.
L’information a émergé sur X (anciennement Twitter), où un utilisateur a partagé une vidéo montrant des t-shirts et des sweats à capuche arborant ce qui semble être une carte stylisée. Les vêtements, exposés dans le rayon dédié aux produits dérivés de jeux vidéo chez Selfridges, présentent un motif cartographique avec des noms de lieux et des routes. La vidéo, devenue virale, a été visionnée des centaines de milliers de fois en quelques heures.
Les images, bien que de qualité moyenne, laissent entrevoir des zones urbaines et rurales, ainsi que des étendues d’eau. Certains internautes ont tenté de comparer ces éléments avec les extraits déjà diffusés par Rockstar, notamment le premier trailer officiel sorti en décembre 2023. Des similitudes ont été relevées, mais rien ne permet encore de confirmer qu’il s’agit bien de la carte définitive du jeu.
Depuis l’annonce officielle de GTA 6 en février 2022, les fuites et rumeurs se multiplient. Le jeu, dont la sortie est prévue pour l’automne 2025 sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series X|S , est l’un des plus attendus de l’histoire du jeu vidéo. Chaque apparition d’un visuel, d’un logo ou d’une information, même minime, suscite une vague d’analyses et de théories.
La carte du jeu est un sujet particulièrement sensible. Les joueurs espèrent un monde ouvert encore plus vaste et détaillé que celui de GTA V , qui avait déjà marqué les esprits par sa taille et sa diversité. Les rumeurs évoquent un retour à Vice City , la ville fictive inspirée de Miami, et l’ajout de zones marécageuses et de plages. La fuite de Selfridges, si elle est authentique, pourrait confirmer certaines de ces hypothèses.
D’après les captures d’écran partagées, la carte imprimée sur les vêtements montre une masse terrestre entourée d’eau, avec plusieurs îles et un littoral découpé. On distingue des zones densément urbanisées, des routes principales et des espaces verts. Certains noms de lieux sont partiellement lisibles, mais leur interprétation reste incertaine. Les fans ont tenté de zoomer sur les images pour identifier des références à des quartiers ou des monuments connus de la série.
Il est important de noter que ces produits dérivés pourraient utiliser une carte stylisée ou conceptuelle, et non la carte exacte du jeu. Les éditeurs ont souvent recours à des visuels promotionnels qui ne reflètent pas fidèlement le contenu final. Néanmoins, la présence d’un tel motif sur des vêtements officiels suggère que Rockstar a validé ce design, ce qui lui donne une certaine crédibilité.
La mise en vente de ces articles chez Selfridges pourrait être une opération marketing orchestrée par Rockstar pour entretenir le buzz autour du jeu. La société a déjà utilisé des stratégies similaires par le passé, distillant des indices dans des produits dérivés ou des mises à jour de sites web. À l’inverse, il pourrait s’agir d’une erreur de la part du fabricant ou du distributeur, qui aurait utilisé un visuel non destiné à être rendu public si tôt.

articles.t: GTA 6 map seemingly leaks at Selfridges merch drop | VGC
articles.chapeau: An apparent GTA 6 map is being shared around online, having been spotted at Selfridges in the UK…
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6’s map appears to have leaked early, thanks to a merch drop in the UK.
Pictures coming out of the GTA 6 collection at Selfridges in London, England , show what appears to be a stylised version of the map used in GTA 6. If true, this reveals some locations from the game ahead of its November 19 release.
The clearest image reportedly comes from an Instagram account that has since been deleted. However, someone else is sharing images of what appears to be the exact same map folded up, as we can spot similarities between the pictures of these maps from these two different sources.
Selfridges in Manchester Exchange Square have got the #GTA6 Collectors Set on display and the Map folded up in the display too.. this means somebody who works there has seen it fully 👀 here what I snapped 😉 @RockstarGames #GTAVI pic.twitter.com/2qfyllsdqI
An image of another map, also incredibly stylised, is being shared around, with some hypothesising that it will be on the other side of the map shared above. However, we do not currently have any other sources sharing images of this alternative map.
Given that the map is folded up at the event itself, it would seem that it wasn’t supposed to be shared publicly at this stage. The map appears to be part of the GTA 6 Collector’s Edition, which is not being sold at Selfridges. Rather, it appears to have simply been a display item to accompany the outlet’s partnership with Rockstar . The Collector’s Edition will be shipped out in time for November 19, the game’s official release date.
This all adds to what has been a marketing campaign full of leaks from start to finish. With a 13-year wait between GTA 5 and GTA 6, fans were left clamouring for information wherever they could find it.
The worst of these leaks saw a group or individual going by the name Cyberleek seemingly gain access to a playable build of the game months before release. They then started sharing full gameplay leaks before Rockstar’s official gameplay reveal via Netflix .

articles.t: Full GTA 6 Map Leaked Online From Collector's Box
articles.chapeau: GTA 6's full physical map has leaked from within the Collector's Box, with images being posted online and doing the rounds.
articles.txt:
If you want to keep yourself hidden from seeing the full GTA 6 physical map that comes in the Collector’s Box, then you’ll want to avoid social media from now until you get your hands on the full release. Images have started circulating online of a hastily snapped picture of the full GTA 6 printed map, revealing some areas we previously didn’t know about.
Users are busy enhancing the image with AI and trying to spot every detail possible. It has been claimed that the image originates from a Selfridges employee, which is the company that hosted a massive GTA 6-themed takeover in the United Kingdom this week.
It’s not an accurate replication of the in-game map, most likely, but it’s what we have. On social media, leaked images purportedly originating from a Selfridges employee have appeared, showcasing the physical, printed map you get when you buy the GTA 6 Collector’s Edition.
Given the obviously sensitive nature of the content, I won’t paste the map here for you to see, but it’s really not tough to find it on social media, whatever your platform of choice may be.
What is does show is a print of ‘The Goodtime State’ that is Leonida, from top to bottom. You’ve got the various counties that make up the territory, all made recognizable with a series of images that could be referred to as ‘Clipart’ showcasing what can be found in that area.
You’ve got monster trucks, a UFO, turtles, some animal playing golf, a city landcape, planes, and much more. It certainly has a retro vibe to it that much of GTA 6 is aiming for; it’s has a throwback feel to it.

articles.t: Full GTA 6 map from Collector's Edition leaks, showing new parts of Leonida
articles.chapeau: The expensive GTA 6 Collector’s Edition includes a sought-after map of Leonida. An Instagram leak has unboxed the collection, displaying nearly the entire poster. The leak divulges new open-world areas, from Lummox County in the north to Pelican Valley in the southern Grassrivers.
articles.txt:
Courtesy of an Instagram leak, fans now have the most complete look yet at the GTA 6 map . The account unboxed the pricey Vice City Collection , exposing the poster and other bonuses. Even with the release date imminent, some regions of Leonida had remained a mystery.
Initially, a display of the Collector’s Box in a Manchester Selfridges store revealed part of the Florida-inspired setting. The poster was folded, but it still provided clues. Goose Key in the southern section was among the unannounced destinations. Tex2 then shared the now-deleted Instagram reel, which shows more of Rockstar’s largest open-world yet.
Aside from some edges of the GTA 6 map, like Leonida Keys, most regions and labels are visible. Included are Lummox County in the north and destinations such as Moreau. Further south, Pelican Valley, found in Grassrivers, is another discovery.
The Netflix Extended Look trailer suggested the game would have tolls. That appears to be the case, since the print references the paid roadways. The cartoonish design also features a blimp icon, a real-world aircraft spotted flying over the United States.
Pre-order buyers must spend $400 on Goodtime State – Vice City Collection to acquire the navigational aid. Fans had hoped the physical GTA 6 Xbox and PS5 copies would offer the map. Past Rockstar titles like GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 had taken this approach.
The studio will make a downloadable digital map available on or shortly after the release date. On the other hand, the retail boxes do contain a double-sided poster with cover art and the previously seen Bikini Girl.
Take-Two or Rockstar may have recently targeted the GTA 6 Mapping Project . The community effort had pieced together a chart of Vice City and Leonida using screenshots and trailers . While its Discord server apparently received a DMCA strike, the resource’s website is accessible. The project will search for more clues in the latest Instagram leak.
